releaseNotes.title: Release Notes Summary R7.18.0.00
releaseNotes.intro: This release delivers extensive regulatory, functional, and technical enhancements across EBA, ECB, ESMA, SRB, and national reporting modules. Key improvements include updated taxonomies, enhanced allocation logic, new data fields, cross‑module consistency fixes, and expanded support for country‑specific rules. Below is a structured summary of the most impactful changes.

matcher.title: Regulation–Release Note Matcher
matcher.subtitle: Traces every release note to the regulation provisions it affects: evidence-backed links, verbatim-verified quotes from both sources, and a complete audit trail.
matcher.deleteBody: The run's results and audit trail are deleted permanently. The release notes and regulations are not affected.

interpret.title: Interpret
interpret.body: Each release note is restated in regulatory terms – German business terms such as EWB or PWB are translated into the regulation's vocabulary.

retrieve.title: Retrieve
retrieve.body: Hybrid keyword and semantic search over every article, plus provisions that name the note's concepts and the provisions they cross-reference.

adjudicate.title: Adjudicate
adjudicate.body: The model links the note only to retrieved provisions, grades each link direct or indirect and quotes both sources word for word.

verify.title: Verify
verify.body: Every quote is checked verbatim; scope, empowerment clauses, shared concepts and reference chains are tested, with one self-correction round.

review.title: Review
review.body: A second, independent model call challenges every accepted link – confirm, downgrade or reject – and disagreements are escalated to you.

closedSet.title: Closed candidate set
closedSet.body: The model may only link provisions retrieved from the regulation text, by id – it cannot invent articles or paragraphs.

verbatim.title: Verbatim quotes
verbatim.body: Every regulation and release-note quote is matched against the source text; typo-level differences are replaced by the exact wording, anything else is rejected.

scope.title: Scope check
scope.body: The provision's title must apply to the exposures the note concerns (e.g. loans are not 'other non credit-obligation assets').

substantive.title: Substantive provisions only
substantive.body: Empowerment clauses that only mandate technical standards or delegated acts are never accepted as links.

concept.title: Shared regulatory concept
concept.body: A linked paragraph must itself deal with the concept the note changes (e.g. general vs specific credit risk adjustments).

references.title: Reference chains
references.body: Provisions that a linked rule applies 'in accordance with' are followed and either linked or dismissed with a reason.

selfCorrection.title: Self-correction
selfCorrection.body: Failed checks are sent back to the model once with the reasons; links that still fail are rejected and listed.

noForcing.title: No forced links
noForcing.body: A note without a governing provision is reported as 'no link' – after a challenge round when candidates name its concepts.

fourEyes.title: Four-eyes review
fourEyes.body: A second, independent model call challenges every accepted link from the provision text: it confirms, downgrades it to indirect or rejects it; when it rejects every link of a note, the note is escalated as 'Needs review'.

lineageAgent.title: Technical Lineage AI Agent
lineageAgent.subtitle: Derives the column-level lineage of an execution's code by static data-flow analysis, proves it by replaying the code and probing every input column, and documents every column with a grounded, four-eyes-reviewed AI explanation.
lineageAgent.deleteBody: The lineage, the AI documentation and the audit trail of this analysis are deleted permanently. The execution, its code and its dataset are not affected.

parse.title: Static data-flow analysis
parse.body: Reads the code's syntax tree: every column write, the columns it reads, conditions, lookup tables, loops and functions.

replay.title: Execution replay
replay.body: Re-runs the code statement by statement in the platform sandbox and attributes every changed cell to a line of code.

probe.title: Dependency probes
probe.body: Changes, empties and fills each input column in turn and records which outputs react: lineage proven by experiment.

document.title: AI documentation
document.body: The LLM explains every derived column, citing code lines; citations outside the verified lineage are rejected.

review.title: Four-eyes review
review.body: A second AI pass checks each explanation against the code; an investigator agent resolves any disagreement.

setup.probesBody: Recommended. Runs the code once per probe (about three per input column) to confirm every dependency empirically. Switch off only for very slow scripts.
